Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished transparent 2D in-game creature sprite for a feudal strategy game, NOT a concept painting scene or UI mockup.
Primary request: one spirewing wyvern in exact side profile facing RIGHT. A lean powerful wyvern with a long sweeping S-curved neck, narrow refined predatory head, elongated curved natural horns and tall narrow folded wings. Slim muscular chest and athletic digitigrade hind legs. Long tapering whip tail.

Hundreds of fine overlapping curved scales follow anatomical volumes. Smoothly shaded large muscle planes, realistic leather wing membranes with fine creases/veins. Gritty majestic grounded original design. Not cartoon, not diagrams, not flat geometric primitives.
Pose: standing naturally on TWO hind legs and on the folded wing thumb knuckles. Both forelimbs are bat-like folded wings attached at shoulders. Fingers and accordion wing membranes folded along the flank and swept backward; not an additional front arm/leg. Slight natural depth offset makes far hind leg and far folded wing visible. Tail extends left, curves slightly with entire tip visible.
RIDING REQUIREMENT: broad smooth clear living back just BEHIND the neck and BETWEEN the two wing shoulder roots, a visible horizontal patch long enough to seat a person. No spikes in this saddle patch. No rider and no installed saddle, tack or armour; runtime game adds them. Back ridge spines resume behind the riding patch. Wings do not cross above that patch where the rider will sit.
Palette: cool neutral charcoal and silver-grey living scales and skin, charcoal-grey leathery wing membranes, softer pale grey underside. Material luminance richly varied, not monochrome flat fills. The neutral body will be tinted to gem colors by the game while preserving its texture. Natural horns dark warm brown keratin; eye is a small clear amber iris.
Claws and teeth: biological curved claws on hind toes and WING THUMBS only, with polished pale silver gem-like facets and sharp highlights; visible curved fang tips in a slightly parted jaw have the same polished mineral look.
